item.text:
Goal and actor: A Fresh Run of Codex will produce a response-only Markdown implementation plan for a fictional offline bookmark manager.
Deliverable and inputs: The only input is the approved Context Dump; the deliverable is a Node.js-and-TypeScript plan, with no files or source code created.
In scope: A CLI-only local bookmark manager with `bookmarks add <url> [--title <title>] [--tag <tag>...]`, `bookmarks list`, and `bookmarks remove <id>`; one JSON store; OS-specific per-user data paths; canonical URL handling; validation; and a test/verification plan.
Exclusions: GUI, cloud sync, network access, external services, search/filter/sort features, remove-by-URL, and implementation work.
Constraints: Target Tool is Codex in a Fresh Run; the English Final Prompt is capped at 900 English words; use Node.js and TypeScript; store JSON under the app folder in XDG data home (Linux), Application Support (macOS), or LocalAppData (Windows).
Acceptance Criteria and evidence: The plan specifies exact successful add/list/remove behavior; persisted additions survive a new process; list shows all bookmarks in stable creation order in a human-readable ID/URL/title/tags table; remove by ID deletes only that item; tests cover URL validation and malformed JSON; duplicate canonical URLs fail without changing JSON.
Failure conditions and edge cases: Invalid URL, missing ID, and malformed JSON fail clearly and safely; URLs are parsed, stored, and compared using the standard URL implementation’s canonical serialized form; duplicate canonical URLs are rejected without mutation.
Remaining assumptions: Stable IDs are generated by the planned implementation; title and tags are optional; `createdAt` is recorded; list has no filters or alternate ordering; storage uses atomic-write guidance to minimize corruption risk.

Please reply `approve` to authorize generation of the three final artifacts, or specify the field you want changed.
